validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="name" expr="'Ada'"/></datamodel>
  <final id="a">
    <onentry>
      <log label="greeting" expr="'Hello, ' + $name + '!'"/>
      <log label="sum" expr="1 + 2"/>
      <log label="numeric" expr="'1' + 2"/>
    </onentry>
  </final>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `+` adds numbers in XPath, so adding the string 'Hello, ' yields `NaN`
notes: XPath converts both operands of `+` to numbers; a string that is not a number converts to `NaN`, and `NaN` plus anything is `NaN`
spec_references: SCXML CR 2014 §C.3 The XPath Data Model
